changes.title: Menus open and close from their own button
changes.detail: The gear and Quick Settings close on a second press; Settings and Search have a visible ×; a quick click elsewhere closes them.

changes.title: Window previews on by default
changes.detail: Live previews on hover, like Windows; turning them off again sticks.

changes.title: Smoother Dock, no white flash
changes.detail: Faster magnification, hover and reorder; no thin bright line when Search opens or the style changes.

changes.title: Dock styles keep menu sizes
changes.detail: Styles no longer change drop-up widths; the Taskbar style opens Settings and Search like Windows 11.

changes.title: Setup starts from your desktop
changes.detail: First run picks your light/dark mode, wallpaper colour and nearest look; Skip changes nothing.

changes.title: Windows accent only on request
changes.detail: Lens copies its accent into Windows only with 'Also use this accent in Windows' ticked (off by default).

changes.title: Clean theme switching
changes.detail: Theme switches in Settings are instant with no growing or flashing; themes change colours only.

changes.title: Window dots cover the real buttons
changes.detail: The native Close button no longer lights up under the dots; they follow move, maximise, snap and restore; the green dot opens Snap Layouts.

changes.title: Safer sign-in
changes.detail: With Start with Windows on, Lens waits for the real desktop; hold Shift at sign-in to skip Lens.

changes.title: Protected Windows keys
changes.detail: Ctrl+Alt+Del, Ctrl+Shift+Esc, Alt+F4, Win+L, Win+D and Win+Tab always reach Windows.

changes.title: Click through the Top Bar
changes.detail: Only the bar's buttons take clicks; elsewhere the click goes to the app underneath.

changes.title: Monitor changes handled
changes.detail: The Dock and Top Bar are re-placed on monitor, resolution, scaling or sleep changes; new 'Follow the pointer'.

changes.title: Pop-outs close by themselves
changes.detail: Quick Settings and Settings close about 1.5 s after the pointer leaves.

changes.title: Auto-hidden Top Bar stays hidden
changes.detail: It no longer pops back up after a settings save or Search.

changes.title: Lens › row in right-click menus
changes.detail: One Lens row slides into Magic actions; Explorer has a Lens menu inside folders and on drives.

changes.title: Site permission prompts
changes.detail: Camera, mic, location, notifications and clipboard requests show a Lens bar: Block, Allow once, Allow on this site.

changes.title: Simpler sidebar
changes.detail: Tabs first, pinned icons in one row, Find a tab with Ctrl+Shift+A.

changes.title: One Simple / Advanced switch
changes.detail: At the top of the sidebar; plus one plain shortcuts cheat sheet.

changes.title: Restart to update and Report a problem
changes.detail: Updates are announced outside Settings; a built-in bug report.

changes.title: Renderer crash recovery
changes.detail: A renderer that exits during start-up is reloaded; the Dock always comes back.

changes.title: Magic waves scaffold
changes.detail: Groundwork for Dashboard, Magic Mouse and more; everything off.

test_steps.steps: Turn on Start with Windows (Settings › Quick), sign out and in; then repeat holding Shift.
test_steps.expected: No error windows; Lens appears only after the normal desktop; with Shift, Lens does not start.

test_steps.steps: Put a browser right under the Top Bar and click its tabs and title bar through the bar.
test_steps.expected: The browser gets the clicks; the bar's own buttons still work; no dead zones.

test_steps.steps: Open Notepad, hover the top-right corner; maximise, snap (Win+Left), restore, resize; rest on the green dot.
test_steps.expected: Native Close never turns red or shows a tooltip; dots stay on the corner; green dot opens Snap Layouts.

test_steps.steps: With two screens: unplug one or change resolution or scaling; sleep and wake; try Monitor › Follow the pointer.
test_steps.expected: Dock and Top Bar land on a real screen in the right place; Follow the pointer moves on an edge push.

test_steps.steps: With a Lens menu open press Ctrl+Shift+Esc, Alt+F4, Win+D, Win+L.
Press the Dock gear twice, Top Bar Quick Settings twice; open Search and use × and Esc.
test_steps.expected: Second press closes; × and Esc close Search; nothing reopens by itself.

test_steps.steps: Set the Top Bar to auto-hide; while hidden change a setting, then open and close Search.
test_steps.expected: The bar hides again and never stays stuck.

test_steps.steps: Open Quick Settings from the Dock and move the pointer away.
test_steps.expected: Closes after about 1.5 s; never while the pointer is over it.

test_steps.steps: Hover a running app on the Dock, then move away.
test_steps.expected: Live previews appear beside the Dock and go away; none stuck in a corner.

test_steps.steps: Settings › About & Testing › Setup: press Skip; reopen and press Finish.
test_steps.expected: Opens in your desktop's colours; Skip changes nothing; Finish changes only what you picked.

test_steps.steps: In Lens Browser open a site that asks for camera or location.
test_steps.expected: A Lens bar under the address bar; Esc blocks; 'Allow on this site' is remembered and can be forgotten in Settings.

test_steps.steps: Change the Lens accent with 'Also use this accent in Windows' off, then on.
test_steps.expected: Windows' accent changes only when the box is ticked.

known_issues: A renderer crash during start-up can freeze Lens for up to a minute before recovery (B-31b); seen only in automated tests.
Lens's File Explorer entries are under Show more options on Windows 11; with the new 'Customize menu' (KB5127936) hiding app extensions may hide them.
The desktop tab and edge Shelf may still briefly resize their window (B-30).
One-click transcription setup is blocked until download hashes are pinned (B-07).
After KB5132061 some other Windhawk taskbar mods stop loading; turn them off and on. Lens's own mod is unaffected.
Going back to the first theme pack doesn't restore folder colours (B-39).
Top Bar click-through and its halo were verified only by automated tests; please confirm on a real PC.
